data.title: Terra Heights
data.about:
Terra Heights is an amazing project at Expo Living Dubai by Emaar, just a short stroll from Expo City With exceptional infrastructure, seamless metro connectivity, and breathtaking views, it offers exquisite 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Combining luxury, comfort, and modern living, Terra Heights floor plan is thoughtfully designed, offering spacious layouts to suit contemporary lifestyles.  

Surrounded by lush green parks, walking trails, and family-friendly spaces, Terra Heights Residences Dubai redefines community living. Its vibrant design fosters outdoor activities and creates a serene atmosphere for residents.  

Luxury amenities at Terra Heights include cultural attractions, cutting-edge recreational areas, and state-of-the-art facilities. With sustainable innovation and dynamic architecture, Terra Heights sets a new benchmark for urban living in Dubai, blending style, connectivity, and community in perfect harmony.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Excellent Connectivity and Luxury Amenities at Terra Heights
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Terra Heights at Expo Living Dubai is strategically located in Dubai South near Dubai Expo Mall. The project also enjoys proximity to the metro station and Al Matoum International Airport, the city's future mega gateway.
  • Modern Residences: Offers thoughtfully designed 1 and 2-bedroom apartments with spacious Terra Heights floor plans.  
  • Family-Friendly Environment: Features green spaces, walking trails, playgrounds, and community engagement for a serene lifestyle.    
  • Vibrant Community: A hub fostering cultural exchange, creativity, and global collaboration in Dubai’s dynamic new epicenter.  
  • The Courtyard: The podium-level courtyard at Terra Heights, with its beautifully landscaped gardens and open spaces, is the perfect spot to relax or connect with friends.
  • Flexible Payment Plan at Terra Heights: Start your investment with just a 10% down payment, making it easier to secure your dream home.

location_tile.title: Expo Valley: Dubai’s New Futuristic Epicenter
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Terra Heights location in Expo Living integrates cutting-edge architecture, green spaces, and state-of-the-art facilities, creating a thriving community. Expo Living by Emaar is part of the Dubai South Community.

Offering an irrestible investment opportunity, Expo Living is a dynamic new development aims to attract global talent and investments, fostering a collaborative atmosphere that nurtures creativity and entrepreneurship. With a mix of cultural attractions, educational institutions, and recreational facilities, it enhances residents' quality of life while positioning Dubai as a premier destination for international events and conferences, cementing its reputation as a city of the future.

  • Next to Expo Mall
  • Close to Metro Station
  • Near Expo City
  • 5 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 15 Minutes to Jebel Ali
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
